note: Frontier release radar: expected upcoming models + market-implied odds, adversarially verified against real markets/announcements.

items.basis: Missed a third launch deadline (Jul 17) after a ground-up pretraining restart; Google now weighing a stopgap upgraded Flash over shipping the full 3.5 Pro tier. No specs published.
Polymarket's dated GPT-6 market prices ~68% by Dec 31 and ~39% by Sep 30 (under 2% this month); OpenAI's line still flows through the GPT-5.6 family, keeping the numbered flagship a late-2026 story.
Anthropic's ~6-week Opus cadence (4.6 Feb, 4.7 Apr, 4.8 May) points to a next Opus; Polymarket prices a next Claude Opus at ~99% by Oct 31 (98% by Dec), version unannounced.
xAI shipped Grok 4.5 on Jul 8; markets price Grok 5 single-digit near-term. The 6T V9-foundation model is reportedly still training on Colossus 2, with public access likely slipping to Q3+.
V4-Pro/Flash shipped Apr 24 as previews; a stable GA is reportedly targeted for Jul 24 2026, per DeepSeek's developer notes.
